questions.question: What is a man after God's own heart?
questions.recommendation: 1 Samuel 13:14 The Lord has sought for Himself a man after His own heart.

options.text: David always sought to sincerely please God
Acts 13:22 I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after My own heart, who will do all My will

questions.question: Since when did the Spirit of God accompany David?
questions.recommendation: The prophet Samuel was sent by God to anoint David as king.

options.text: 1 Samuel 16:13 Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers; and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward.
When he was made King of Israel

questions.question: How did the Spirit of God show Himself when David was a shepherd?
questions.recommendation: The Spirit of God works in a special way in a man for a purpose.

options.text: I was anointed with oil as king by the prophet Samuel

1 Samuel 17:34-36 Your servant used to keep his father's sheep, and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock, I went out after it and struck it, and delivered the lamb from its mouth; and when it arose against me, I caught it by its beard, and struck and killed it. Your servant has killed both lion and bear.

questions.question: How did he face Goliath? Not with what!
questions.recommendation: Great problems, great solutions. We must not face them alone.

options.text: 1 Samuel 17:45 You come to me with a sword, with a spear... but I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts!
With a sling and a stone, which killed him

questions.question: Once Goliath was defeated, were his troubles over?
questions.recommendation: Success and fame brought him the king's envy.

options.text: The people sang: Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands!
Saul wanted to kill him out of envy

questions.question: Why was David angered when he heard Goliath's insults?
questions.recommendation: The Spirit of God was with David!

options.text: Because David loved God and could not help defending Him, even though he was only a boy!
Because his brothers were soldiers and he also wanted to be a soldier

questions.question: If our heart needs to be changed, should we ask for it?
questions.recommendation: We have a sinful nature and we live in a sinful world.

options.text: Psalm 51:10 Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me
Separate ourselves from the world

questions.question: What keeps a man united to God?
questions.recommendation: John 15:5 Without Me you can do nothing.

options.text: John 14:23 If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him
Belonging to the church, taking part in its activities and seeking God

questions.question: Out of the heart flows life. How should we guard it?
questions.recommendation: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked; who can know it? Jeremiah 17:9.

options.text: Out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks. Luke 6:45
Psalm 119:9 How can a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.

questions.question: What lessons can you draw?
questions.recommendation:
Many lessons can be drawn, but above all: please God and be recognized by Him as a man after His heart.
*Do not grieve the Spirit of God; instead, let Him work. 
*Enter into a covenant with God with an eternal dynasty: God assured David that his house (his royal line) and his throne would be established forever! 
*Worship as a way of life. David is known as the sweet psalmist of Israel.

options.text: Going to church on Sundays
Having a pure heart and obeying God in everything
